content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The agreement's only IP-ownership provision (Article III, p0048) runs entirely in Licensor's favour, and the broad "Derivative Work" definition (p0005) sweeps in the customization work and unique client front end we pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087). We receive no ownership, no assignment, and no durable licence — our rights are a restricted, non-exclusive Field-of-Use licence that Article XXI (p0138) automatically terminates, with modification and sublicensing barred by Article II. Nothing addresses our trading/transaction data.

Classified as a **deviation** against the fallback, cured with two surgical operations: a short inserted paragraph granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Deliverables for our business plus a limit confining any Licensor right in our data to processing solely to provide the services; and a minimal conforming edit to Article XXI so that licence survives termination. Licensor's ownership of the Licensed Technology and its know-how is left intact and mapped as already met.
